title: Media Coverage Highlights Designing With Older Adults
summary: A shared feature draws attention to participation, privacy, and trust in ELARA's companion robot research.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post
The Humanoids4Good feature shared by Park

paragraphs.text: On September 5, 2026, Chorong Park shared a Humanoids4Good feature about ELARA's approach to developing care robots with older adults. The post is a link-only share, directing readers to coverage based on University of Houston reporting.

The university's original account describes older adults as contributors to design, working with students to provide feedback and model ideas for future companion robots. It identifies privacy and feeling comfortable with a system as important considerations alongside function and accessibility.

The coverage offers a way into the lab's participatory research, not evidence that a finished care robot is already in use. Readers can follow the original university report for the research context and the community's role.
